baseline: saved hard_100_park Jan-Jun unchanged spot trade/accounting trace
bounds: conditional paper instrument; fractional short availability not established
no historical futures basis, orderbook liquidity, real borrow/funding, exchange margin or account eligibility certification
saved spot values can contain stale marks and are not executable liquidation quotes
no original2000-account funded profit claim; all hedge collateral comes from explicit equal extra cash
no production code changes, live orders or holdout access
carry_cost_assumption: synthetic constant adverse net funding/borrow charge on open-time short notional prorated each5m bar; no actual historical venue funding used
drawdown: total account sampled only at authentic saved hourly spot observations (and independently verified exactJune boundary if available), not full5m portfolio max drawdown
execution: first exact 5m OPEN at signal_timestamp +300; missing exact opening bar => reject pending order, no delayed stale fill
liquidation_model: if synthetic collateral at full5m BTC HIGH breaches maintenance, conservatively cover at HIGH with adverse costs and penalty; prohibit further hedges after first liquidation; retain negative balances as liabilities; spot and PARK never seized
margin_rules: synthetic 100%-notional initial reserve and80%-notional maintenance; these are paper stress assumptions not actual venue specifications
missing_btc_bar_policy: Never fabricate OHLC. Preserve last observed mark as state until next actual observed price, cancel any exact-time missing execution, apply synthetic carry on last observed notional for missing interval, report every open-position missing interval; intra-gap margin breach remains UNKNOWN and results are conditional on no unseen liquidation.
policy: target fractional BTC-index short units = ratio * latest OBSERVED marked spot inventory / observed completed BTC close; no beta or parameter fitting
signal_frequency: saved hourly portfolio observations, first at Jan1 00:05UTC; no constructed intrahour spot marks
terminal: retain short marked at final completed BTC close, disclose exposure and unrealized status; do not assume future close fill
